title: self draining soap dish
text: self draining soap dish. I was looking for a self draining soap dish to place my bottle of handsoap and also my dishsoap bottle on to help drain off the water that always is running around them.... it does NOT work for that.  But it would be a great self draining soap dish for a bar of soap - which is what it is made for.  The reason it won't work for my purpose because it has long silicone sticks - which give.  So a bottle of handsoap or dishsoap will wobble and fall when you pump them.

product_metadata.title: YAMAZAKI home 2995 Self Draining Soap Tray-Floating Holder Dish for Sink, One Size, Black
description: This soap tray by Yamazaki brings a modern look to the bathroom or kitchen. It is self-draining in order to remove excess liquid from the soap.
